data.one_liner: A customizable Tinder‑style card swiper for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that displays a stack of cards you can swipe in any direction, with full control over animation, thresholds, and background cards. It exposes a controller to programmatically trigger swipes and listen to swipe events.
use_when: You need a Tinder‑style swipe interface
You want full control over swipe directions and thresholds
You need to programmatically trigger swipes or listen to swipe progress
avoid_when: You only need a simple carousel or page view
You need a pre‑built UI kit that includes many widgets
strengths: Supports all swipe directions and programmatic control
Lightweight with only two cards rendered at a time
weaknesses: No built‑in persistence or state management
Limited to card‑style UI, not a general carousel
